subject: Pushed: expanded multiply_lower_tri_self_transpose and new diagonal matrix multiplication

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Pushed: expanded multiply_lower_tri_self_transpose and new diagonal matrix multiplication
parts:
Just a heads up.  I had a bit of time today and I've pushed two changes.

1) multiply_lower_tri_self_transpose can now handle non-square matrices.  Further, the tests now properly reflect the fact that it should ignore entries in the upper triangular portion of the matrix.

2) I've add diag_pre_multiply and diag_post_multiply which does multiplication by a diagonal matrix given in the form of a vector.  Currently it doesn't case whether the input is a row or column vector, only that the sizes match.  The version there will be a little slow for doubles.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: Pushed: expanded multiply_lower_tri_self_transpose and new diagonal matrix multiplication
parts:
Oh, and I forgot one other change:

3) Added a function block(A,i,j,nr,nc) which extracts the nr x nc submatrix of A starting at row i and column j. 

Cheers,
Marcus
